question: What is ChatGPT?
definition: ChatGPT is an AI-powered conversational chatbot developed by OpenAI. It is built on the Generative Pre-trained Transformer (GPT) architecture and is designed to understand and generate human-like text based on user prompts.
history: ChatGPT was introduced by OpenAI in November 2022. It is based on GPT language models trained on large datasets of books, websites, and articles using deep learning techniques.
future: Future versions of ChatGPT are expected to provide improved reasoning, multimodal capabilities, better accuracy, and deeper integration with business applications.
